choose.when:
AND ( WO.PRODUCT_LOT LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MATERIAL_INOUT MI WHERE MI.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID AND NVL(MI.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND MI.MATERIAL_LOT LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )

AND ( I.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MATERIAL_INOUT MI JOIN ITEM MAT ON MI.ITEM_ID = MAT.ITEM_ID WHERE MI.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID AND NVL(MI.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND MAT.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )
choose.otherwise:
AND ( WO.PRODUCT_LOT LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR WO.DOC_NO LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR PP.DOC_NO LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR I.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR I.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR L.LINE_NAME LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR NVL(LP.PROD_STATUS, '대기') LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR NVL(LI.RESULT, '-') LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR TO_CHAR(WO.ORDER_QTY) LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR TO_CHAR(NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0)) LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR TO_CHAR(NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0)) LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR TO_CHAR( GREATEST( NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) - NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0), 0 ) ) LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%'
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MATERIAL_INOUT MI JOIN ITEM MAT ON MI.ITEM_ID = MAT.ITEM_ID WHERE MI.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID AND NVL(MI.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND ( MI.MATERIAL_LOT LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR MI.DOC_NO LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR MAT.ITEM_CODE LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR MAT.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCTION P WHERE P.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID AND P.DOC_NO LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM INSPECTION INS JOIN PRODUCTION P ON INS.PROD_ID = P.PROD_ID WHERE P.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID AND NVL(INS.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND INS.DOC_NO LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DEFECT_LIST DL JOIN INSPECTION INS ON DL.INSP_ID = INS.INSP_ID JOIN PRODUCTION P ON INS.PROD_ID = P.PROD_ID JOIN DEFECT D ON DL.DEFECT_ID = D.DEFECT_ID WHERE P.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID AND NVL(DL.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND ( DL.DOC_NO LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR D.DEFECT_CODE LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' OR D.DEFECT_NAME LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )
OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM PRODUCT_INOUT PIO WHERE PIO.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID AND NVL(PIO.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND PIO.DOC_NO LIKE '%' || TRIM(#{keyword}) || '%' ) )

mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(NVL(PROD_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_PROD_QTY, SUM(NVL(LOSS_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_LOSS_QTY FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PA ON WO.ORDER_ID = PA.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P1.ORDER_ID, P1.PROD_STATUS FROM PRODUCTION P1 JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, MAX(PROD_ID) AS PROD_ID FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PM ON P1.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID AND P1.PROD_ID = PM.PROD_ID ) LP ON WO.ORDER_ID = LP.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P2.ORDER_ID, I2.RESULT FROM INSPECTION I2 JOIN PRODUCTION P2 ON I2.PROD_ID = P2.PROD_ID JOIN ( SELECT P3.ORDER_ID, MAX(I3.INSP_ID) AS INSP_ID FROM INSPECTION I3 JOIN PRODUCTION P3 ON I3.PROD_ID = P3.PROD_ID GROUP BY P3.ORDER_ID ) IM ON P2.ORDER_ID = IM.ORDER_ID AND I2.INSP_ID = IM.INSP_ID ) LI ON WO.ORDER_ID = LI.ORDER_ID

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT LOT_LIST.*, ROWNUM AS RN FROM ( SELECT WO.ORDER_ID, WO.PROD_PLAN_ID, PP.ITEM_ID,
WO.PRODUCT_LOT, PP.DOC_NO AS PROD_PLAN_DOC_NO, WO.DOC_NO AS WORK_ORDER_DOC_NO,
I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME,
NVL(L.LINE_NAME, '-') AS CURRENT_PROCESS,
WO.ORDER_QTY, NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) AS PROD_QTY, NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0) AS LOSS_QTY, GREATEST(NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) - NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0), 0) AS GOOD_QTY,
CASE WHEN NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE LEAST( 100, ROUND((NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) / WO.ORDER_QTY) * 100) ) END AS PROGRESS_RATE,
NVL(LP.PROD_STATUS, '대기') AS PROGRESS_STATUS, NVL(LI.RESULT, '-') AS INSP_RESULT,
TO_CHAR(WO.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE, TO_CHAR(LP.PROD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_DATE, TO_CHAR(LI.INSP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSP_DATE
FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(NVL(PROD_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_PROD_QTY, SUM(NVL(LOSS_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_LOSS_QTY FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PA ON WO.ORDER_ID = PA.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P1.ORDER_ID, P1.PROD_ID, P1.PROD_STATUS, P1.PROD_DATE, P1.DOC_NO FROM PRODUCTION P1 JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, MAX(PROD_ID) AS PROD_ID FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PM ON P1.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID AND P1.PROD_ID = PM.PROD_ID ) LP ON WO.ORDER_ID = LP.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P2.ORDER_ID, I2.INSP_ID, I2.RESULT, I2.INSP_DATE, I2.DOC_NO FROM INSPECTION I2 JOIN PRODUCTION P2 ON I2.PROD_ID = P2.PROD_ID JOIN ( SELECT P3.ORDER_ID, MAX(I3.INSP_ID) AS INSP_ID FROM INSPECTION I3 JOIN PRODUCTION P3 ON I3.PROD_ID = P3.PROD_ID GROUP BY P3.ORDER_ID ) IM ON P2.ORDER_ID = IM.ORDER_ID AND I2.INSP_ID = IM.INSP_ID ) LI ON WO.ORDER_ID = LI.ORDER_ID
ORDER BY WO.ORDER_DATE DESC, WO.ORDER_ID DESC ) LOT_LIST WHERE ROWNUM <= #{endRow} ) WHERE RN >= #{startRow}

SELECT WO.ORDER_ID, WO.PROD_PLAN_ID, PP.ITEM_ID, LP.PROD_ID, LI.INSP_ID, WO.PRODUCT_LOT, PP.DOC_NO AS PROD_PLAN_DOC_NO, WO.DOC_NO AS WORK_ORDER_DOC_NO, LP.DOC_NO AS PROD_DOC_NO, LI.DOC_NO AS INSP_DOC_NO, I.ITEM_CODE, I.ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN I.ITEM_TYPE = 'RM' THEN '원자재' WHEN I.ITEM_TYPE = 'SM' THEN '부자재' WHEN I.ITEM_TYPE = 'FG' THEN '완제품' ELSE NVL(I.ITEM_TYPE, '-') END AS ITEM_TYPE, I.ITEM_UNIT, NVL(I.SAFETY_STOCK, 0) AS SAFETY_STOCK, CUS.CLIENT_CODE, CUS.CLIENT_NAME, CUS.CLIENT_TYPE, CUS.BUSINESS_NO AS CLIENT_BUSINESS_NO, CUS.CLIENT_ADRESS AS CLIENT_ADDRESS, CUS.CLIENT_MAN AS CLIENT_MANAGER, CUS.CLIENT_TEL, CUS.CLIENT_DEPT, NVL(IV.INVENTORY_STOCK, 0) AS INVENTORY_STOCK, NVL(IV.STOCK_LOCATION, '-') AS STOCK_LOCATION, IV.INVENTORY_REMARK, NVL(PIS.PRODUCT_IN_QTY_TOTAL, 0) AS PRODUCT_IN_QTY_TOTAL, NVL(PIS.PRODUCT_OUT_QTY_TOTAL, 0) AS PRODUCT_OUT_QTY_TOTAL, NVL(PIS.PRODUCT_IN_QTY_TOTAL, 0) - NVL(PIS.PRODUCT_OUT_QTY_TOTAL, 0) AS PRODUCT_REMAIN_QTY, L.LINE_CODE, NVL(L.LINE_NAME, '-') AS LINE_NAME, NVL(L.LINE_NAME, '-') AS CURRENT_PROCESS, PP.PROD_PLAN_QTY, WO.ORDER_QTY, NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) AS PROD_QTY, NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0) AS LOSS_QTY, GREATEST(NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) - NVL(PA.TOTAL_LOSS_QTY, 0), 0) AS GOOD_QTY, NVL(LI.INSPECTION_QTY, 0) AS INSPECTION_QTY, CASE WHEN NVL(WO.ORDER_QTY, 0) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE LEAST(100, ROUND((NVL(PA.TOTAL_PROD_QTY, 0) / WO.ORDER_QTY) * 100)) END AS PROGRESS_RATE, NVL(LP.PROD_STATUS, '대기') AS PROGRESS_STATUS, NVL(LI.RESULT, '-') AS INSP_RESULT, TO_CHAR(PP.PROD_PLAN_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_PLAN_DATE, TO_CHAR(PP.DUE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DUE_DATE, TO_CHAR(WO.ORDER_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ORDER_DATE, TO_CHAR(LP.PROD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_DATE, TO_CHAR(LI.INSP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSP_DATE, E.ENAME, E.DEPT, EWO.ENAME AS WORK_ORDER_EMP_NAME, WO.REMARK, WO.QR_URL, WO.QR_IMAGE_PATH
FROM WORK_ORDER WO
JOIN PRODUCTION_PLAN PP ON WO.PROD_PLAN_ID = PP.PROD_PLAN_ID
JOIN ITEM I ON PP.ITEM_ID = I.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN CLIENT CUS ON I.CLIENT_ID = CUS.CLIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, SUM(NVL(INVENTORY_STOCK, 0)) AS INVENTORY_STOCK, MAX(STOCK_LOCATION) AS STOCK_LOCATION, MAX(REMARK) AS INVENTORY_REMARK FROM INVENTORY GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IV ON I.ITEM_ID = IV.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN LINE L ON WO.LINE_ID = L.LINE_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP EWO ON WO.EMP_ID = EWO.EMP_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(NVL(PROD_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_PROD_QTY, SUM(NVL(LOSS_QTY, 0)) AS TOTAL_LOSS_QTY FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PA ON WO.ORDER_ID = PA.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(CASE WHEN INOUT_TYPE IN ('MI', 'PI', '입고') THEN NVL(INOUT_QTY, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS PRODUCT_IN_QTY_TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN INOUT_TYPE IN ('MO', 'PO', '출고') THEN NVL(INOUT_QTY, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS PRODUCT_OUT_QTY_TOTAL FROM PRODUCT_INOUT WHERE NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PIS ON WO.ORDER_ID = PIS.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P1.ORDER_ID, P1.PROD_ID, P1.EMP_ID, P1.PROD_STATUS, P1.PROD_DATE, P1.DOC_NO FROM PRODUCTION P1 JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, MAX(PROD_ID) AS PROD_ID FROM PRODUCTION GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PM ON P1.ORDER_ID = PM.ORDER_ID AND P1.PROD_ID = PM.PROD_ID ) LP ON WO.ORDER_ID = LP.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP E ON LP.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT P2.ORDER_ID, I2.INSP_ID, I2.RESULT, I2.INSP_DATE, I2.DOC_NO, I2.INSPECTION_QTY FROM INSPECTION I2 JOIN PRODUCTION P2 ON I2.PROD_ID = P2.PROD_ID JOIN ( SELECT P3.ORDER_ID, MAX(I3.INSP_ID) AS INSP_ID FROM INSPECTION I3 JOIN PRODUCTION P3 ON I3.PROD_ID = P3.PROD_ID GROUP BY P3.ORDER_ID ) IM ON P2.ORDER_ID = IM.ORDER_ID AND I2.INSP_ID = IM.INSP_ID ) LI ON WO.ORDER_ID = LI.ORDER_ID
WHERE WO.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}

SELECT MI.INOUT_ID, MI.ORDER_ID, MI.ITEM_ID AS MATERIAL_ITEM_ID, MAT.ITEM_CODE AS MATERIAL_ITEM_CODE, MAT.ITEM_NAME AS MATERIAL_ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN MAT.ITEM_TYPE = 'RM' THEN '원자재' WHEN MAT.ITEM_TYPE = 'SM' THEN '부자재' WHEN MAT.ITEM_TYPE = 'FG' THEN '완제품' ELSE NVL(MAT.ITEM_TYPE, '-') END AS MATERIAL_ITEM_TYPE, NVL(MI.DOC_NO, 'MIO-' || MI.INOUT_ID) AS MATERIAL_DOC_NO, MI.MATERIAL_LOT, MI.INOUT_TYPE, CASE WHEN MI.INOUT_TYPE = 'MI' THEN '입고' WHEN MI.INOUT_TYPE = 'MO' THEN '출고' WHEN MI.INOUT_TYPE = 'MO-PROD' THEN '생산투입' ELSE NVL(MI.INOUT_TYPE, '-') END AS INOUT_TYPE_NAME, NVL(MI.INOUT_QTY, 0) AS INOUT_QTY, TO_CHAR(MI.INOUT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INOUT_DATE, NVL(MI.STATUS, '-') AS INOUT_STATUS, E.ENAME AS INOUT_EMP_NAME, MI.REMARK AS MATERIAL_REMARK FROM MATERIAL_INOUT MI
JOIN ITEM MAT ON MI.ITEM_ID = MAT.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP E ON MI.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
WHERE MI.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND NVL(MI.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
ORDER BY MI.INOUT_DATE ASC, MI.INOUT_ID ASC

SELECT P.PROD_ID, P.ORDER_ID, P.DOC_NO AS PROD_DOC_NO, TO_CHAR(P.PROD_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PROD_DATE, NVL(P.ORDER_QTY, WO.ORDER_QTY) AS ORDER_QTY, NVL(P.PROD_QTY, 0) AS PROD_QTY, NVL(P.LOSS_QTY, 0) AS LOSS_QTY, GREATEST(NVL(P.PROD_QTY, 0) - NVL(P.LOSS_QTY, 0), 0) AS GOOD_QTY, NVL(P.PROD_STATUS, '-') AS PROD_STATUS, NVL(P.INSPECTION_STATUS, '-') AS INSPECTION_STATUS, E.ENAME AS PROD_EMP_NAME, P.REMARK AS PROD_REMARK FROM PRODUCTION P
JOIN WORK_ORDER WO ON P.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP E ON P.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
WHERE P.ORDER_ID = #{orderId}
ORDER BY P.PROD_DATE ASC, P.PROD_ID ASC

SELECT I.INSP_ID, I.PROD_ID, P.ORDER_ID, I.DOC_NO AS INSP_DOC_NO, I.INSP_TYPE, TO_CHAR(I.INSP_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS INSP_DATE, NVL(I.INSP_STATUS, '-') AS INSP_STATUS, NVL(I.RESULT, '-') AS INSP_RESULT, NVL(I.INSPECTION_QTY, 0) AS INSPECTION_QTY, NVL(I.GOOD_QTY, 0) AS INSPECTION_GOOD_QTY, GREATEST(NVL(I.INSPECTION_QTY, 0) - NVL(I.GOOD_QTY, 0), 0) AS INSPECTION_BAD_QTY, E.ENAME AS INSP_EMP_NAME, I.REMARK AS INSP_REMARK FROM INSPECTION I
JOIN PRODUCTION P ON I.PROD_ID = P.PROD_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP E ON I.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
WHERE P.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND NVL(I.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
ORDER BY I.INSP_DATE ASC, I.INSP_ID ASC

SELECT DL.DEFECT_LIST_ID, DL.DEFECT_ID, DL.INSP_ID, P.ORDER_ID, DL.DOC_NO AS DEFECT_DOC_NO, D.DEFECT_CODE, D.DEFECT_NAME, D.DEFECT_TYPE, NVL(DL.DEFECT_QTY, 0) AS DEFECT_QTY, TO_CHAR(DL.DEFECT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS DEFECT_DATE, DL.DEFECT_PHOTO, DL.REMARK AS DEFECT_REMARK, NVL(DA.ACTION_COUNT, 0) AS ACTION_COUNT, TO_CHAR(DA.ACTION_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS ACTION_DATE, DA.ACTION_CONTENT FROM DEFECT_LIST DL
JOIN DEFECT D ON DL.DEFECT_ID = D.DEFECT_ID
JOIN INSPECTION I ON DL.INSP_ID = I.INSP_ID
JOIN PRODUCTION P ON I.PROD_ID = P.PROD_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT DEFECT_LIST_ID, COUNT(*) AS ACTION_COUNT, MAX(ACTION_DATE) AS ACTION_DATE, LISTAGG(ACTION_CONTENT, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY SORT_NO, DEFECT_ACTION_ID) AS ACTION_CONTENT FROM DEFECT_ACTION WHERE NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY DEFECT_LIST_ID ) DA ON DL.DEFECT_LIST_ID = DA.DEFECT_LIST_ID
WHERE P.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND NVL(DL.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
ORDER BY DL.DEFECT_DATE ASC, DL.DEFECT_LIST_ID ASC

SELECT PIO.INOUT_ID AS PRODUCT_INOUT_ID, PIO.ORDER_ID, WO.PRODUCT_LOT AS PRODUCT_INOUT_PRODUCT_LOT, PIO.ITEM_ID, IT.ITEM_CODE AS PRODUCT_INOUT_ITEM_CODE, IT.ITEM_NAME AS PRODUCT_INOUT_ITEM_NAME, CASE WHEN IT.ITEM_TYPE = 'RM' THEN '원자재' WHEN IT.ITEM_TYPE = 'SM' THEN '부자재' WHEN IT.ITEM_TYPE = 'FG' THEN '완제품' ELSE NVL(IT.ITEM_TYPE, '-') END AS PRODUCT_INOUT_ITEM_TYPE, IT.ITEM_UNIT AS PRODUCT_INOUT_ITEM_UNIT, NVL(IT.SAFETY_STOCK, 0) AS PRODUCT_INOUT_SAFETY_STOCK, PIO.INSP_ID, INSP.DOC_NO AS PRODUCT_INOUT_INSP_DOC_NO, NVL(PIO.DOC_NO, 'PIO-' || PIO.INOUT_ID) AS PRODUCT_INOUT_DOC_NO, PIO.INOUT_TYPE AS PRODUCT_INOUT_TYPE, CASE WHEN PIO.INOUT_TYPE IN ('MI', 'PI', '입고') THEN '입고' WHEN PIO.INOUT_TYPE IN ('MO', 'PO', '출고') THEN '출고' ELSE NVL(PIO.INOUT_TYPE, '-') END AS PRODUCT_INOUT_TYPE_NAME, NVL(PIO.INOUT_QTY, 0) AS PRODUCT_INOUT_QTY, TO_CHAR(PIO.INOUT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PRODUCT_INOUT_DATE, NVL(PIO.STATUS, '-') AS PRODUCT_INOUT_STATUS, NVL(E.ENAME, '-') AS PRODUCT_INOUT_EMP_NAME, PIO.REMARK AS PRODUCT_INOUT_REMARK, CUS.CLIENT_CODE AS PRODUCT_INOUT_CLIENT_CODE, CUS.CLIENT_NAME AS PRODUCT_INOUT_CLIENT_NAME, CUS.CLIENT_TYPE AS PRODUCT_INOUT_CLIENT_TYPE, CUS.BUSINESS_NO AS PIO_CLIENT_BIZ_NO, CUS.CLIENT_ADRESS AS PRODUCT_INOUT_CLIENT_ADDRESS, CUS.CLIENT_MAN AS PRODUCT_INOUT_CLIENT_MANAGER, CUS.CLIENT_TEL AS PRODUCT_INOUT_CLIENT_TEL, CUS.CLIENT_DEPT AS PRODUCT_INOUT_CLIENT_DEPT, NVL(IV.INVENTORY_STOCK, 0) AS PRODUCT_INOUT_INVENTORY_STOCK, NVL(IV.STOCK_LOCATION, '-') AS PRODUCT_INOUT_STOCK_LOCATION, IV.INVENTORY_REMARK AS PRODUCT_INOUT_INVENTORY_REMARK, NVL(PIS.PRODUCT_IN_QTY_TOTAL, 0) AS PRODUCT_INOUT_LOT_IN_QTY, NVL(PIS.PRODUCT_OUT_QTY_TOTAL, 0) AS PRODUCT_INOUT_LOT_OUT_QTY, NVL(PIS.PRODUCT_IN_QTY_TOTAL, 0) - NVL(PIS.PRODUCT_OUT_QTY_TOTAL, 0) AS PRODUCT_INOUT_LOT_REMAIN_QTY
FROM PRODUCT_INOUT PIO
JOIN WORK_ORDER WO ON PIO.ORDER_ID = WO.ORDER_ID
JOIN ITEM IT ON PIO.ITEM_ID = IT.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN CLIENT CUS ON IT.CLIENT_ID = CUS.CLIENT_ID
LEFT JOIN INSPECTION INSP ON PIO.INSP_ID = INSP.INSP_ID
LEFT JOIN EMP E ON PIO.EMP_ID = E.EMP_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ITEM_ID, SUM(NVL(INVENTORY_STOCK, 0)) AS INVENTORY_STOCK, MAX(STOCK_LOCATION) AS STOCK_LOCATION, MAX(REMARK) AS INVENTORY_REMARK FROM INVENTORY GROUP BY ITEM_ID ) IV ON PIO.ITEM_ID = IV.ITEM_ID
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ORDER_ID, SUM(CASE WHEN INOUT_TYPE IN ('MI', 'PI', '입고') THEN NVL(INOUT_QTY, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS PRODUCT_IN_QTY_TOTAL, SUM(CASE WHEN INOUT_TYPE IN ('MO', 'PO', '출고') THEN NVL(INOUT_QTY, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS PRODUCT_OUT_QTY_TOTAL FROM PRODUCT_INOUT WHERE NVL(USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY ORDER_ID ) PIS ON PIO.ORDER_ID = PIS.ORDER_ID
WHERE PIO.ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND NVL(PIO.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
ORDER BY PIO.INOUT_DATE ASC, PIO.INOUT_ID ASC
